title: The diagnosis and treatment of shoulder injuries in the throwing athlete.

sections.label: OBJECTIVE
sections.text: To discuss the general diagnostic and therapeutic considerations involved in managing patients with shoulder injury.

sections.label: DATA SOURCES
sections.text: Medline search going back 10 years, and using the key terms "throwing" and "shoulder injuries."

sections.label: DATA SYNTHESIS
sections.text: Papers which evaluated current treatment protocols as determined by previously published papers in peer reviewed journals or textbooks that had no confounding variables were examined.

sections.label: RESULTS
sections.text: The throwing motion is a complex maneuver which requires coordination of a variety of structures. Depending upon the specific kind of injury, rehabilitation may involve numerous different approaches. A 4-phase rehabilitation program is described.

sections.label: CONCLUSION
sections.text: Synthesis of the literature regarding management of throwing injuries is described.
